title: DispatchRecord
description: Intent for one autopilot phase dispatch, written before the adapter is invoked and patched with agent_id afterwards. Design D2. This schema describes a COMPLETE record as stored. The wire payloads differ and are defined by the OpenAPI DispatchRecordCreate (full field set, first insert) and DispatchRecordPatch (dispatch_id plus the fields being patched, e.g. agent_id on the adapter return path). A patch of {dispatch_id, agent_id} is legitimate and validates against DispatchRecordPatch; it deliberately does NOT satisfy this schema's required list, which applies to the stored row.

phase.description: Autopilot dispatch phase. This enum MUST equal agents_config.NON_TERMINAL_PHASES; terminal phases (DONE, ESCALATE, ERROR) are not dispatched and so are never recorded. Two corrections from the first draft: GATEKEEPER was missing although autopilot dispatches it as a judge sub-agent (autopilot SKILL.md step 1.5, agents_config.py NON_TERMINAL_PHASES), so every gatekeeper record would have failed validation — a systematic blind spot in a ledger whose whole purpose is to record every dispatch. REVIEW_PANEL was present but exists nowhere else in the repository, so a record could have validated against a phase no dispatcher emits.

record_kind.description: Whether this dispatch actually invoked a sub-agent. 'dispatched' records join to usage on (session_id, agent_id) and are flagged unattributed when no usage matches. 'state_only' records (INIT, SUBMIT_PR) and 'judge' records that run in-process carry no sub-agent, so they have a NULL agent_id BY DESIGN and MUST be excluded from mismatch accounting — otherwise the join, in which SQL NULLs never match, reports them as failures on every single run and the mismatch report is noise from the first day.

usage_session_id.description: Session under which this dispatch's usage is recorded. Equals session_id for a Claude sidechain; the vendor's own session id for Codex/Grok/Pi, whose sub-agents run as top-level sessions. The mismatch join is on (usage_session_id, agent_id); joining on session_id would match nothing for those three vendors.
